source_admission: Published values used as constants or quoted ranges for population.py and population.md; no external dataset files are admitted to Git. 'access' records how far each source was checked on 2026-10-09: 'full text' means the document itself was read (local text copies kept with the domain's run records on the research drive, provisioning-runs/population/); 'abstract' means the publisher's or an index's abstract; 'reported via search summary' means a web search's summary of the source, not re-read; 'web page' means a page read through a fetching tool. Repository products and documents are cited by path in population.md and bound by hash in the product.
